text:
Situation: Corvale East holds 204 units of granisetron hydrochloride 1 mg tablets at 7.6 units per day, giving 27 days of supply. Corvale General holds 135 units at 9.1 units per day, giving 15 days of supply.

Why (FDA record): The product label for NDC 69452035001 identifies OrBion Pharmaceuticals Private Limited (FEI 3004540907) as the manufacturing plant for analysis, labeling, manufacture, and pack. FDA inspection records for that plant show VAI classifications on 2011-04-07, 2015-06-03, 2019-05-31, and 2023-09-08. The most recent inspection listed is an NAI classification dated 2025-10-27. Granisetron hydrochloride is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers the near term at both sites. No shortage is declared by FDA. Alternative manufacturers are available but their manufacturing sites are not identified on their labels.

Recommended actions:
1. Verify Breckenridge Pharmaceutical's manufacturing site before purchase; buyer to confirm and P&T committee to approve.
2. Verify Natco Pharma Limited's manufacturing site before purchase; buyer to confirm and P&T committee to approve.
3. Rebalance stock between Corvale East and Corvale General to equalize days of supply; buyer to execute and pharmacy director to approve.

Not recommended: Initiate emergency purchasing or allocation restrictions at this time.
